title: Key Binding
description: Publishes a cryptographic key associated with an ID. Supports multi-purpose bindings, rotation, and revocation. Each attestation binds one key to one service.

@context.description: Optional JSON-LD context URI for semantic processing.

attester.title: Attester ID
attester.description: DID or address of the service authorizing this key binding.

subject.title: Service ID
subject.description: ID of the service that is authorizing the Key ID.

keyId.title: Key ID
keyId.description: DID representing this key. If the keyId is self-certifying (did:jwk, did:pkh:eip155, did:pkh:solana), publicKeyJwk is optional.

publicKeyJwk.title: Public Key (JWK)
publicKeyJwk.description: JWK-formatted public key. Required if keyId is not self-certifying. Paste the full public JWK JSON object. Private key material (d, k) is rejected.

keyPurpose.title: Authorized Use
keyPurpose.description: What the key is authorized to do based on the W3C DID Core specification. A key should not be used for both signing and encryption.

x-oma3-enum.label: Shared Control
x-oma3-enum.description: Authorize transactions, authenticate to dApps, and act on behalf of the DID

x-oma3-enum.label: Signatures
x-oma3-enum.description: Sign attestations, verifiable credentials, and other structured data

x-oma3-enum.label: Encryption
x-oma3-enum.description: Establish encrypted channels and perform key exchange (ECDH). Do not combine with signing purposes.

revoked.title: Revoked
revoked.description: Indicates if this key binding has been revoked. For EAS, this is handled natively by the protocol.

revokedAt.title: Revocation Date
revokedAt.description: Time the key binding was revoked. For EAS, this is recorded on-chain natively.

proofs.title: Proofs
proofs.description: One or more proofs that demonstrate the service's authorization of the key. Optional when verifiers can confirm authorization through other means (e.g., DNS TXT, did.json, or controller witness for did:web/did:pkh IDs).

issuedAt.title: Issued Date
issuedAt.description: Time the key binding was issued. Default is current time.

effectiveAt.title: Effective Date
effectiveAt.description: Time the key binding becomes effective. Default is current time.

expiresAt.title: Expiration Date
expiresAt.description: Time the key binding expires. Default is no expiration.

then.description: If keyId is self-certifying — did:jwk (key embedded in the DID), did:pkh:eip155 (key recoverable from any ECDSA signature), or did:pkh:solana (address is the ed25519 public key) — publicKeyJwk is optional (but allowed).

else.description: If keyId is NOT self-certifying (e.g. did:pkh on chains whose addresses are hashes of the key, such as Sui or Cosmos), publicKeyJwk is strictly required.
